title: Smoked Grilled Steak with Chwinamul Sauce
description: A delicious and savory dish featuring grilled steak served with a rich and creamy chwinamul sauce. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Season the steak with salt, black pepper, and grill seasoning. Let it sit for 15-20 minutes to allow the seasonings to penetrate the meat.
Grill the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
In a blender or food processor, combine chwinamul, chicken broth, keenly, and syrian. Blend until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the blended chwinamul mixture and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the chwinamul sauce.
Garnish with smoked paprika, if desired.
